Jungle Fever#000.src: Talk to Worid in the jungle village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#001.src: Oh, I am so happy to see you! *cough*, I caught a very bad fever, and I really need help! *cough*
Jungle Fever#001.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#002.src: The only cure against this fever is to drink Liquid Emeralds! Yes, exactly! *cough*
Jungle Fever#002.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#003.src: Do you think you could ask the Banker at {p} if he could give me, oh I don't know, [{~} Liquified Emeralds]?
Jungle Fever#003.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#004.src: If he has the audacity to *cough* say no... you will have to use brute force...
Jungle Fever#004.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#005.src: Break into *cough* to the emerald storage, but don't take anything... come back to me immediately after, if you make it out alive, heheh...
Jungle Fever#005.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#007.src: Talk to {p}'s Banker about the cure for Worid at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#008.src: [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? He is crazy! Liquified Emeralds cannot cure anyone from anything, except being poor!
Jungle Fever#008.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#009.src: I will not participate in this pathetic fraud attempt!
Jungle Fever#009.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#011.src: Oh no! How will I ever cure my sickness without any Liquified Emeralds?... *cough*
Jungle Fever#011.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#012.src: We'll have to change our strategy, we won't ask for permission. It's to help me after all.
Jungle Fever#012.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#013.src: First, I need to make sure you can easily break into a bank. Try to enter {p}' Secret Stash.
Jungle Fever#013.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#014.src: When you're done, talk to me again. Be careful too, they might have some Guards.
Jungle Fever#014.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#016.src: What? You're here already. I thought you would take too long so I just went myself.
Jungle Fever#016.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#017.src: My sickness? RIGHT. *cough* You should feel bad for forcing a sick man to do your job.
Jungle Fever#017.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#018.src: Anyway I see you proved yourself, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#018.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#019.src: You see, {p} has a very well guarded emerald vault named "The Emerald Labyrinth".
Jungle Fever#019.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#020.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.
Jungle Fever#020.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#021.src: The Banker in the secret vault must be completely bored out of his mind, and won't mind if you find him.
Jungle Fever#021.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#022.src: Good luck with that. Haha.. I mean, *cough*.
Jungle Fever#022.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#023.src: Infiltrate {p}'s Secret Emerald Labyrinth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] underground and find the Banker in the Emerald Room

Jungle Fever#024.src: Oh, uh! Somebody! It has been so long since I've seen someone!
Jungle Fever#024.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#025.src: Liquified Emeralds? Of course, of course! I've got tons! Here, take them.
Jungle Fever#025.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#028.src: That is a lot of money, thank you very much, I will finally be able to... *cough* to cure myself!
Jungle Fever#028.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#029.src: Here, take this part, you deserve it. I have to use most of the... *cough* money so I can heal, so I've instead paid you with a key.
Jungle Fever#029.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#030.src: I stole- *cough* I mean, borrowed it, from our tribe's leader. Apparently it was used to lock up a great evil.
Jungle Fever#030.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#031.src: Good ridda- *cough* Er... luck. Yes, good luck, adventurer!
Jungle Fever#031.speaker: Worid
